title: Reject Drawing V3 and replace ad-hoc drawing automation with TPD compiler
decision: K01 Drawing V3 PDFs are not eligible for production release. Retain them as negative evidence. Future drawings shall be compiled from requirements + released CAD + tolerance/GD&T definition using native SOLIDWORKS drawing objects and a controlled DRWDOT template.
rationale: The V3 outputs contain contradictory visible/release dimensions and excessive model-derived annotations; these defects cannot be solved by additional visual polishing.
